title: Grateful Dead Live at Old Renaissance Faire Grounds on 1972-08-27
lineage: DAT>WAV via Sony SDT-9000 DDS drive using VDAT 0.6f

ai_review.summary: Stereo soundboard mix delivers a blazing late‑‘72 show with smoking Playing in the Band, China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, Dark Star > El Paso and other classics.
ai_review.review: The dankseed SBD remix is praised for its crystal‑clear stereo separation and balanced mix, making every instrument shine. Musically the concert erupts with high energy—standout performances of Playing in the Band, China Cat Sunflower > Rider, Bird Song, Dark Star > El Paso, Sing Me Back Home and Sugar Magnolia are repeatedly highlighted, despite a minor out‑of‑tune moment on Mexicali. Overall the show is regarded as one of the peak late‑1972 performances.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is ~4.9/5, with consistent praise for both the high‑quality stereo soundboard source and the energetic musical performance; only one modestly critical review slightly lowers the composite score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as the most 'stereo' sounding version, crystal‑clear SBD remix with superb balance; no reported dropouts or mix issues.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Three strong sets with the first set building momentum after five songs; tight transitions especially China>Rider and a powerful second‑set jam flow leading into Dark Star > El Paso, ending with high‑energy encores.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his great tone and adventurous lead work, especially during Dark Star and the transition into El Paso.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass solo in Dark Star noted as groovy; overall solid foundation throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals and rhythm guitar highlighted—particularly on Sugaree and Jack Straw—with heartfelt delivery praised.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann (Billy) receives special mention for driving the jams, especially during Dark Star.
